born.why: The code prioritizes survival by eating unknown fruits when hunger is critical (>70-95), while using a cautious "taste-first" strategy for safe exploration at lower hunger levels, and strictly avoiding known poisonous species.

This code prioritizes survival by eating immediately when critically hungry, avoids known poisons by key, and uses a "carry" strategy for safe fruits to reduce travel time, while cautiously tasting new fruits only when sufficiently hungry to justify the risk.

The code improves survival by distinguishing between "unknown" and "unsafe" using trait clustering, reducing false positives on poisonous species, and prioritizing eating over tasting when hunger is critically high to prevent starvation during decision delays.

The code prioritizes survival by eating when starving, uses trait-similarity to avoid unknown fruits that resemble known poisons, and stores safe or unproven-but-safe-looking fruits in the pantry until hunger dictates consumption.

The code improves survival by adding trait-based poison detection (checking smell/color/shape of known poisons) to catch new variants, and prioritizes eating when hungry (<70) while carrying when full to optimize energy efficiency.

The code implements trait-based learning, allowing Fagi to infer safety from shared characteristics (color, shape, smell) across different species, and dynamically adjusts her hunger threshold for eating vs. tasting based on calculated risk scores derived from past experiences.
